run_evaluate_program: run the evaluate function to dynamically import and score a candidate program's C2 solution against the benchmark
verify_c2_solution: verify a C2 lower bound solution using piecewise linear integration on function values and autocorrelation norms
test_evaluate: test the evaluate function by passing a path to a candidate program module that exports a run method
review_verify_c2_solution: review the verify_c2_solution function to understand how L2, L1, and infinity norms are computed from autocorrelation
refactor_evaluate: refactor the evaluate function to support alternative program import strategies or additional scoring metrics
